## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Reduce the legacy fetcher's retry limit before merge because it violates the existing three-attempt policy.

## Changes
The pull request adds inventory fetching and health probing with retries, plus tests for success, HTTP errors, and exhaustion. It also adds a legacy-module exemption to the review rules.

## Critical
- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Cap legacy inventory fetching at three attempts — When the inventory endpoint repeatedly raises OSError, your fetcher makes eight attempts, violating `docs/review-rules.md:5`: “Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts.” — During an upstream outage, eight ten-second connection timeouts and seven sleeps can hold a worker thread for roughly 87 seconds.
